description: This file defines the Language controller class for the startup sequence of the OpenCart catalog system. It manages language selection, loading, and configuration based on request parameters and URL routes.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing language selection and loading during the startup process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the language settings based on request parameters, URL route, and configuration. Loads available languages and sets the current language accordingly.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Post-processing method that overrides default language values after initial load, adjusting language files based on the route and extension.
